description: This source file contains unit tests for font handling behaviors related to Windows font usage within the PDFsharp library. It uses the Xunit testing framework to verify behaviors under different platform configurations, such as Windows, WSL2, and core builds.

classes.name: UseWindowsFontsTests
classes.description: A test class using Xunit for verifying font usage behavior depending on platform and settings within the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: UseWindowsFonts_not_set
methods.description: Verifies behavior when font management settings are reset without specific platform flags.

methods.name: UseWindowsFontsUnderWindows_set
methods.description: Tests font creation behavior with Windows fonts under different platform conditions.

methods.name: UseWindowsFontsUnderWsl2_set
methods.description: Verifies font behavior when WSL2-specific settings are enabled.
